judge.rationale: The candidate accurately implements usage accumulation across tool rounds, handles partial and completely missing usage metadata without producing NaN, and updates the spec and CHANGELOG as required. It satisfies every acceptance criterion, including driving a full two-tool-round (three provider call) turn in its tests and documenting the summed semantics on the `afterModelResponse` hook signature via JSDoc. However, it exports a `scriptedProvider` test helper directly from the production module `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` (duplicating the one in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`) and leaves the local accumulator variable named `lastUsage`. Compared to the reference, which kept the helper private to `chatOrchestrator.ts`, renamed the hook parameter to `totalUsage`, and added tests directly to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, the candidate splits the helper into `orchestratorHelpers.ts` and adds a separate acceptance test file.
